business_model.basis: Stated in the 10-K Item 7 and the 10-Q Item 2 overviews.
business_model.claim: Range is an independent producer of natural gas, NGLs and oil. It explores for, develops and acquires properties in the Appalachian region, and its portfolio is focused on Pennsylvania.
quotes: We are an independent natural gas, NGLs and oil company engaged in the exploration, development and acquisition of natural gas, NGLs and oil properties located in the Appalachian region of the United States.

business_model.basis: Stated in the 10-K Item 7 overview; the 10-Q overview says the same.
business_model.claim: Range reports a single segment. One company-wide management team runs all properties as a whole, so there is no segment breakdown to analyse.
quotes: We operate in one segment and have a single company-wide management team that administers all properties as a whole rather than by discrete operating segments.

business_model.claim: Sales of natural gas, NGLs and oil are the core revenue line. In the nine months to September 30, 2026 they were 2,450,258 (table in thousands) of total revenues and other income of 2,710,567. Brokered natural gas and marketing revenue added 161,248.

business_model.basis: Stated in the 10-Q MD&A sales table; the liquids-rich explanation comes from the CEO's statement in the earnings release.
business_model.claim: Within sales for the nine months, natural gas was 1,415,649, NGLs 893,016 and oil 141,593 (table in thousands). In the third quarter NGL sales rose 43% against a 3% rise for natural gas, so liquids are an important and growing part of the mix.

Gas exposure is concentrated. About 65% of proved reserves were natural gas at December 31, 2025, and essentially all proved reserves are in Pennsylvania. Gas prices are therefore the main revenue driver, and the company is exposed to one region's regulation and processing and transportation constraints.
quotes: Essentially 100% of our total estimated proved reserves are located in Pennsylvania.

business_model.claim: Revenue moves with realized prices and production volumes. Third-quarter 2026 sales revenue rose 21%, from an 8% rise in average realized prices and a 12% rise in production.
quotes: revenue from the sale of natural gas, NGLs and oil increased 21% from the same period of 2025 due to an 8% increase in average realized prices (before cash settlements on our derivatives) combined with a 12% increase in production volumes

business_model.basis: Stated in the earnings release and the 10-Q benchmark table.
business_model.claim: Prices are set by commodity benchmarks, and Range realizes a differential to them. In the third quarter the average NYMEX gas price was $2.95 and Range's realized gas price, including basis hedging, was $2.40, a differential of ($0.55). The NYMEX gas benchmark was lower year on year, so liquids prices offset weaker gas.
quotes: The average natural gas price, including the impact of basis hedging, was $2.40 per mcf, or a ($0.55) per mcf differential to NYMEX.

business_model.basis: Stated in the 10-K MD&A and the 10-Q income statement.
business_model.claim: Hedging smooths cash flow but adds volatility to reported revenue. Derivative fair value income was 58,118 in the third quarter and 98,229 for the nine months (table in thousands), and it is recorded within total revenues.
quotes: Mark-to-market accounting treatment can result in more volatility in our revenues as the change in fair value of our commodity derivative positions is included in total revenue.

business_model.basis: Stated in the 10-Q income statement and MD&A.
business_model.claim: The largest cost is transportation, gathering, processing and compression, at 349,934 of 618,799 total costs and expenses in the third quarter (table in thousands). It was $1.52 per mcfe against $1.47 a year earlier, mainly from higher processing costs tied to higher commodity prices.
quotes: transportation, gathering, processing and compression per mcfe was $1.52 in third quarter 2026 compared to $1.47 in the same period of 2025, primarily due to increased processing costs that are driven by higher commodity prices

business_model.basis: Stated in the 10-Q income statement and MD&A.

quotes: interest expense per mcfe decreased 50% from the same period of 2025 due to lower debt balances and lower interest rates.

growth_thesis.basis: Stated in P3 and reconciled to the income and cash flow statements.
growth_thesis.claim: Earnings and operating cash flow grew with prices and volumes. Nine-month net income was $712.3 million vs $478.9 million, and operating cash flow rose $247.9 million.
quotes: The higher net income in first nine months 2026 compared to first nine months 2025 is primarily due to increased realized prices combined with an increase in total production.

growth_thesis.basis: Cost figures are stated in P3. The cash margin figure comes from the non-GAAP reconciliation in P5. The cost-risk point is stated in P1.
growth_thesis.claim: Margin growth requires unit costs not to outrun realized prices. Q3 transportation, gathering, processing and compression cost was $1.52 per mcfe vs $1.47, driven by higher processing costs. Q3 cash margin was $1.52 per mcfe vs $1.36.
quotes: transportation, gathering, processing and compression per mcfe was $1.52 in third quarter 2026 compared to $1.47 in the same period of 2025

growth_thesis.basis: Stated in P3 and the balance sheet; the borrowing base risk is stated in P1.
growth_thesis.claim: Lower interest cost lifts earnings. The company redeemed $600 million of 8.25% senior notes due 2029 using credit facility borrowings, and Q3 interest expense per mcfe fell 50% year over year. Continuation requires the credit facility to remain available, as bank debt rose to 284,484 (table in thousands) from 106,700.
quotes: reduced our higher interest rate debt by redeeming $600 million principal balance of our 8.25% senior notes due 2029 by utilizing borrowings under the credit facility

growth_thesis.basis: Share counts and EPS are stated in the release and income statement. The repurchase amount is stated in P3.
growth_thesis.claim: Per-share results benefited from a lower share count. Diluted shares were 235,035 vs 239,026 and Q3 diluted EPS was $0.75 vs $0.60. Nine-month repurchases of $105.5 million drove this, but there were no repurchases in Q3.
quotes: During the quarter, Range did not repurchase shares.

growth_thesis.basis: Stated by management in P5 and P4. The benefits are management's expectations, not demonstrated results.
growth_thesis.claim: The pending all-stock merger with EQT is presented by management as a path to scale. Completion needs shareholder approvals from both companies, HSR clearance, an effective Form S-4 and NYSE listing. Each Range share would convert into 0.987 EQT shares, and a termination fee of $423 million applies in certain terminations.
quotes: We believe our pending transaction with EQT Corporation is a natural next step in our journey that will allow us to scale our business

growth_thesis.basis: Stated in the FY2025 10-K risk factors, which are risk disclosures rather than outcomes.
growth_thesis.claim: Growth depends on continued access to Pennsylvania development. Essentially all proved reserves are in Pennsylvania, and drilling locations are scheduled over multiple years, so growth requires permits, local approvals and capital to keep flowing.
quotes: Essentially 100% of our total estimated proved reserves are located in Pennsylvania.

material_events.basis: stated in the cited items (P3, P4, P5, P6)
material_events.claim: Range signed a merger agreement with EQT for an all-stock combination. Each eligible Range share converts into 0.987 EQT shares at a fixed exchange ratio. Closing is subject to conditions including shareholder approvals and Hart-Scott-Rodino expiration. Range owes EQT a $423 million termination fee in certain terminations.
quotes: If the Merger is completed, each eligible share of our common stock outstanding immediately prior to the Merger will automatically be converted into the right to receive 0.987 shares of EQT common stock.

material_events.basis: stated in P3, with the loss figure from the F2 income statement; the redemption date is not given
material_events.claim: During the first nine months of 2026 Range redeemed $600 million principal of its 8.25% senior notes due 2029, using credit facility borrowings. It recorded a loss on early extinguishment of debt of 12,344 (table in thousands) for the nine months.
quotes: reduced our higher interest rate debt by redeeming $600 million principal balance of our 8.25% senior notes due 2029 by utilizing borrowings under the credit facility, while retaining $1.5 billion in available liquidity under our credit facility.

risks.basis: Stated in the 10-Q risk factors (P4) and the 8-K (P6). The probability of failure is not stated.
risks.claim: The all-stock merger with EQT may not close. Range would owe EQT a termination fee of $423 million in certain terminations, and either party may terminate if the merger is not completed within 12 months, extendable to 18 months.
quotes: We can provide no assurance that the required shareholder approvals will be obtained or that the required conditions to the closing will be satisfied.
either we or EQT may terminate the Merger Agreement if the Merger has not been completed within 12 months after the date of the Merger Agreement

risks.basis: Stated as a risk factor in P4. No actual regulatory action is shown in the evidence.
risks.claim: Antitrust authorities or state attorneys general could act against the EQT merger, for example by seeking to enjoin it or to require divestitures.
quotes: seeking to enjoin the completion of the Merger

risks.basis: Stated in P4. The effect on value is inferred from the fixed-ratio mechanics.
risks.claim: The merger consideration is a fixed exchange ratio of 0.987 EQT shares per Range share, so what Range holders receive moves with the EQT share price until closing.
quotes: This exchange ratio is fixed and will not be adjusted for changes in the market price of either EQT common stock or our common stock.

risks.basis: Stated as a risk factor in P4; the absence of visible damage comes from P5 and F2.
risks.claim: Range's operations could be disrupted while the merger is pending. Staff and counterparties may be unsettled, management attention is diverted, and the merger agreement may restrict strategic opportunities.
quotes: the Merger Agreement may restrict us from pursuing attractive business opportunities or strategic transactions that may arise prior to completion of the Merger

risks.basis: Benchmark prices are stated in P3 and the reserve mix in P1. The earnings effect of lower gas prices is inferred from the risk factors.
risks.claim: Natural gas price weakness is a live exposure. The Q3 2026 average NYMEX gas price was $2.95 per mcf versus $3.07 a year earlier, and about 65% of proved reserves were natural gas at year-end 2025.
quotes: approximately 65% of our proved reserves were natural gas as of December 31, 2025

risks.basis: Balances are stated in F1 and F3 and availability in P3. The exposure is inferred from the borrowing-base risk factor in P1.
risks.claim: Bank debt rose to 284,484 (table in thousands) at Sep. 30, 2026 from 106,700 at Dec. 31, 2025. Credit facility borrowing capacity is subject to a lender-set borrowing base.
quotes: The amount available for borrowing under our bank credit facility is subject to a borrowing base
maintained substantial liquidity with $1.5 billion available under our credit facility

risks.basis: Stated in the 10-K risk factors (P1). The severity is inferred from the concentration.
risks.claim: Essentially all of Range's proved reserves are in Pennsylvania, so state or local regulation, such as setback rules or a fracking restriction, would affect the company heavily.
quotes: Essentially 100% of our total estimated proved reserves are located in Pennsylvania.
We do not expect action on the requested rulemaking for the foreseeable future and believe that the petition and requested rulemaking are unlawful.

unresolved_questions.basis: Stated in the 10-Q risk factors and the 8-K; no outcome is in the packet.
unresolved_questions.claim: Will the all-stock Merger with EQT be completed? Shareholder approvals, antitrust clearance, Form S-4 effectiveness and NYSE listing are still outstanding.
quotes: The Merger may not be completed and the Merger Agreement may be terminated in accordance with its terms.

unresolved_questions.basis: Ratio stated in the 10-Q; EQT price absent, so the implied value is unknown.
unresolved_questions.claim: What consideration will Range holders actually receive? The exchange ratio is fixed at 0.987 EQT shares per Range share, and EQT's share price is not in the evidence.
quotes: This exchange ratio is fixed and will not be adjusted for changes in the market price of either EQT common stock or our common stock.

unresolved_questions.basis: The fee amount is stated; the triggering events are not in the excerpts, as the 8-K text is truncated.
unresolved_questions.claim: In which termination scenarios would Range owe EQT the termination fee, and does EQT owe a reciprocal fee?
quotes: we will be required, in certain terminations, to pay EQT a termination fee of $423 million

unresolved_questions.basis: Budget and Q3 spend are stated; any later update or 2027 plan is not in the evidence.
unresolved_questions.claim: Will full-year 2026 spending and production stay within the announced plan, and what is the outlook beyond 2026? Range will not hold a conference call because of the pending merger.
quotes: we expect our capital budget to be in the range of $650 million to $700 million
Due to the pending merger with EQT, Range will not host a conference call or webcast to discuss its third quarter 2026 results.

unresolved_questions.basis: The balances are on the balance sheet; the contract terms and payment schedule are not in the packet.
unresolved_questions.claim: What is the divestiture contract obligation, over what period will it be settled, and how large are its cash payments? It is carried as both a current and a non-current liability and runs through exit costs.
quotes: Divestiture contract obligation | 75,258 | 75,842

unresolved_questions.basis: Balances and the redemption are stated; facility terms and merger treatment of debt are not in the excerpts.
unresolved_questions.claim: What are the credit facility's maturity, borrowing base and covenant terms, and how does the Merger affect Range's debt? Bank debt was used to redeem senior notes.
quotes: reduced our higher interest rate debt by redeeming $600 million principal balance of our 8.25% senior notes due 2029 by utilizing borrowings under the credit facility, while retaining $1.5 billion in available liquidity under our credit facility.

unresolved_questions.basis: Facts are stated; the reason and any covenant limits are inferred as unknown, not given.
unresolved_questions.claim: Has the Merger restricted share repurchases, or dividends, going forward? Range bought back stock earlier in 2026 but none in the third quarter.
quotes: During the quarter, Range did not repurchase shares.
repurchased $105.5 million (2.8 million shares) of our common stock;

unresolved_questions.basis: The basis-hedge value is stated; the volume and price schedule is absent.
unresolved_questions.claim: How much of 2027 and later production is hedged, and at what prices? The packet gives only basis-hedge fair value and settlements.
quotes: The combined fair value of natural gas basis hedges as of September 30, 2026, was a net loss of $8.4 million.

unresolved_questions.basis: Figures are stated; the drivers and the timing of reversal are not in the packet.
unresolved_questions.claim: When will cash taxes rise toward book tax expense? Nine-month current tax is small against deferred tax, and the deferred tax liability grew.

unresolved_questions.basis: The reserve share is stated; reserve volumes, standardized measure and any update after year-end 2025 are not in the evidence.
unresolved_questions.claim: What are the current proved reserves, reserve life and reserve mix? Only the gas share of proved reserves at year-end 2025 appears, while liquids production is rising.
quotes: Natural gas prices are likely to affect us the most because approximately 65% of our proved reserves were natural gas as of December 31, 2025

unresolved_questions.basis: The company's view is stated in the 10-K; the regulator's path is unknown.
unresolved_questions.claim: Will Pennsylvania advance statewide setback rules that could restrict Range's drilling? A citizen petition was accepted for review.
quotes: We do not expect action on the requested rulemaking for the foreseeable future and believe that the petition and requested rulemaking are unlawful.

verdict_reason: an offer to acquire the company is announced and pending: the price follows the offer's terms, not the company's standalone value (on the value alone: AVOID, expected return -7.3 points a year against the required return over 3 years)
